measures.name: Supplier OTD Status
measures.dax:
VAR _v = [OTD%] * 100
VAR _g = LOOKUPVALUE ( Ref_Risk_Thresholds[GreenThreshold], Ref_Risk_Thresholds[Metric], "On-Time Delivery (Inbound)" )
VAR _a = LOOKUPVALUE ( Ref_Risk_Thresholds[AmberThreshold], Ref_Risk_Thresholds[Metric], "On-Time Delivery (Inbound)" )
RETURN
    IF ( ISBLANK ( [OTD%] ), BLANK (), SWITCH ( TRUE (), _v >= _g, "On Track", _v >= _a, "Watch", "At Risk" ) )

measures.name: PL Contribution Margin Var pp
measures.dax:
IF (
    NOT ISBLANK ( [PL Contribution Margin % PY] ),
    ( [PL Contribution Margin %] - [PL Contribution Margin % PY] ) * 100
)

measures.name: PL CY
measures.dax:
VAR y = [PL Anchor Year]
RETURN CALCULATE ( [PL Amount], Dim_Date[Year] = y )

measures.name: PL Freight % of Net Revenue
measures.dax: DIVIDE ( -CALCULATE ( [PL CY], REMOVEFILTERS ( 'PL Lines' ), 'PL Lines'[LineID] = 6 ), CALCULATE ( [PL CY], REMOVEFILTERS ( 'PL Lines' ), 'PL Lines'[LineID] = 3 ) )

measures.name: PL Period Label
measures.dax:
VAR y = [PL Anchor Year]
RETURN y & " - " & ( y - 1 )

measures.name: Supplier Defect Status
measures.dax:
VAR _v = [Supplier Defect Rate %] * 100
VAR _g = LOOKUPVALUE ( Ref_Risk_Thresholds[GreenThreshold], Ref_Risk_Thresholds[Metric], "Supplier Defect Rate" )
VAR _a = LOOKUPVALUE ( Ref_Risk_Thresholds[AmberThreshold], Ref_Risk_Thresholds[Metric], "Supplier Defect Rate" )
RETURN
    IF ( ISBLANK ( [Supplier Defect Rate %] ), BLANK (), SWITCH ( TRUE (), _v <= _g, "On Track", _v <= _a, "Watch", "At Risk" ) )

measures.name: CY_line
measures.dax:
-- use the hidden Order column: referencing the display column of a field-parameter table raises a composite-key error
VAR sel = SELECTEDVALUE ( 'CY_Dynamic Line'[CY_Dynamic Line Order], 0 )
RETURN
    SWITCH (
        sel,
        0, [Revenue],
        1, [OTIF%],
        2, [In_full %],
        3, [On_Time %]
    )

measures.name: Freight Status

RETURN
    IF ( ISBLANK ( [Freight % of Sales] ), BLANK (), SWITCH ( TRUE (), _v <= _g, "On Track", _v <= _a, "Watch", "At Risk" ) )

measures.name: Gross Margin Status
measures.dax:
VAR _v = [Gross Margin %] * 100

RETURN
    IF ( ISBLANK ( [Gross Margin %] ), BLANK (), SWITCH ( TRUE (), _v >= _g, "On Track", _v >= _a, "Watch", "At Risk" ) )

measures.name: Inventory Turn Over (Annul)
measures.dax:
var _moths = DISTINCTCOUNT(Fact_Inventory[SnapshotDate])
var _anuuaCOGS = DIVIDE([Total COGS],_moths)*12

RETURN
DIVIDE(_anuuaCOGS,[Avg Inventory Value])

measures.name: PL Var %

measures.name: PY_line
measures.dax:
VAR sel = SELECTEDVALUE ( 'CY_Dynamic Line'[CY_Dynamic Line Order], 0 )
VAR cur = [CY_line]
RETURN
    IF (
        NOT ISBLANK ( cur ),
        SWITCH (
            sel,
            0, CALCULATE ( [Revenue],   DATEADD ( Dim_Date[Date], -12, MONTH ) ),
            1, CALCULATE ( [OTIF%],     DATEADD ( Dim_Date[Date], -12, MONTH ) ),
            2, CALCULATE ( [In_full %], DATEADD ( Dim_Date[Date], -12, MONTH ) ),
            3, CALCULATE ( [On_Time %], DATEADD ( Dim_Date[Date], -12, MONTH ) )
        )
    )

measures.name: Revenue YoY % (vs PY)
measures.dax:
VAR _y = YEAR(DATE("2024","12","31"))
VAR _cur = CALCULATE ( [Revenue], REMOVEFILTERS ( Dim_Date ), Dim_Date[Year] = _y )
VAR _py = CALCULATE ( [Revenue], REMOVEFILTERS ( Dim_Date ), Dim_Date[Year] = _y - 1 )
RETURN
    DIVIDE ( _cur - _py, _py )

measures.name: PL Amount
measures.dax:
VAR lineId = SELECTEDVALUE ( 'PL Lines'[LineID] )
VAR gross = [Gross Sales (List Price)]
VAR disc = [Total Discount Value]
VAR netrev = [Revenue]
VAR cogs = [Total COGS]
VAR gp = [Gross_Profit]
VAR frt = [Freight Cost]
VAR ppv = [PPV (Purchase Price Variance)]
RETURN
    SWITCH (
        lineId,
        1, gross,
        2, -disc,
        3, netrev,
        4, -cogs,
        5, gp,
        6, -frt,
        7, -ppv,
        8, gp - frt - ppv
    )
